'''Xom''' was an individual who lived during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Xom was the son of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Xer VIII|Xer]] of the [[Kingdom of Argai]], and the brother of [[Xil]], [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], [[Xic]] and [[Xuc]]. According to the play ''[[The Pirate Prince]]'', which was made by the [[Lisst'n]] dramatist [[Lyechusas]], the existence of Xom, Xil, Xic and Xuc was kept secret from Xim. When Xer eventually introduced Xim to his brothers while on [[Argai]], Xim killed Xom, Xil, Xic and Xuc, so that he wouldn't have to share Xer's wealth with them. Xer was overcome with grief, so Xim killed his father as well and then made himself the new king.
